faq_heading: Price Reduced Homes for Sale in Abbotsford: your questions answered

faq.q: How much below asking are homes selling for in Abbotsford?
faq.a: SnapStats puts October 2026 at 97% of list price for Abbotsford detached homes (3% below) and 98% for condos and townhomes (2% below).

faq.q: Is Abbotsford a buyer's market or a seller's market?
faq.a: By the SnapStats reading, October 2026 was a balanced market for detached homes (18% sales ratio) and a balanced market for condos and townhomes (16%). A ratio of 12% to 20% counts as balanced; lower favours buyers and higher favours sellers.

faq.q: How long do Abbotsford homes take to sell?
faq.a: The typical Abbotsford detached home took 38 days to sell in October 2026, and a condo or townhome 30 days.

faq.q: Which price range has the most unsold detached homes in Abbotsford?
faq.a: $1,000,001 to $1,250,000, with 121 detached homes for sale and 23 sold in October 2026.

blocks.text: This search lists Abbotsford homes where the asking price has dropped by at least 1%, pulled live from the MLS®. Land and income properties are left out; houses, townhomes and condos are all included. Read each reduction against recent sales, not against the old asking price alone. In October 2026 a typical Abbotsford detached home sold for $1,060,000, took 38 days and closed at 97% of its list price, with 410 detached homes for sale and 72 sold in the month.
What a price drop means in Abbotsford right now

Detached homes in Abbotsford have been selling about 3% under list price, and condos and townhomes about 2% under. On the detached side the sales ratio was 18%, which SnapStats reads as a balanced market. For condos and townhomes it was 16%, also a balanced market. Most small drops simply close the distance to recent sale prices. A large one means the home started well above the market, and the history of its price changes is worth asking for.

Supply is the other half. At October's pace the 410 detached listings would take 5.7 months to sell, and the 546 condo and townhome listings 6.1 months. Against October 2025, detached listings are 13% fewer and detached sales 33% more, which is the backdrop for how many price changes you will see.
Abbotsford detached homes by area: where buyers have room

Reductions cluster in the areas where detached listings outnumber buyers. In October that was Central Abbotsford (79 listings, 8% sales ratio). The fastest-moving area was Aberdeen, at a 30% ratio on 7 sales, so cuts there tend to be small or short-lived.

blocks.text: Price ranges with the most unsold Abbotsford detached homes

The busiest price range for listings was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000, with 121 homes for sale and 23 sold. The slowest of the well-stocked ranges were $1,500,001 to $1,750,000 (32 for sale, 2 sold); $1,750,001 to $2,000,000 (30 for sale, 3 sold); $1,250,001 to $1,500,000 (97 for sale, 14 sold). Expect the most flexibility from sellers in those ranges.
